spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: seems confused and asks the colleague to repeat things

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’ve got a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really fed up with the bank. It’s happened before and I’m getting nowhere.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been so frustrating, Callum. Before I look at anything on the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. I can see the payment you’re concerned about. Could you tell me which one you mean?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The one for £86.40 to Northstar Media on the 19th of October. I’ve never used them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why that would worry you. I’ll log this as a complaint about the payment and your experience trying to get help.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry, what are you doing? I didn’t catch that.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m logging a complaint for you, which means we’ll review what’s happened and send you a response. You’ll hear back within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Eight weeks? And what happens with the money? I’m getting a bit confused by all this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, I know there’s a lot to take in. I can slow down and go over it again, or give you extra time to think. We also have a Financial Support team if you’d like help with anything making this difficult.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Could you repeat what you’ve actually done, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Certainly. I’ve logged your concern as a complaint. The response is due within eight weeks, and I can’t promise what the outcome will be. Does that make sense so far?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I think so. You’ve logged a complaint, but you can’t tell me if I’ll get the money back.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. The complaint will be reviewed, but I can’t say what the decision will be. Is there anything else you’d like me to explain?
